title: US Iran deal memo talks gain momentum after Trump pauses Strait mission
desc: Reports from a US media outlet suggest the White House may be close to a preliminary memorandum aimed at ending the conflict with Iran, following a decision by Donald Trump to pause a naval operation in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Uganda passes ‘foreign agents’ bill as Museveni tightens grip
desc: Parliament approves a contentious sovereignty law mirroring Russian-style curbs on dissent, despite warnings from human rights groups that the 20-year prison sentences will stifle civil society and risk economic isolation.

desc: Sources like wind and solar can now deliver continuous power, according to a new report. And, they’re often a bargain compared with fossil fuels.

title: Heavy rain causes flash floods in parts of Petaling Jaya and Kuala Lumpur
